method: UMAP (n_neighbors=30, min_dist=0.3, seed 42) on standardised Campbell 52-dim syllable features; clusters: HDBSCAN on t-SNE(3d, seed 42, ms=25, mcs=50) -> 50 clusters + 4483 unclustered. 19815 Koe syllables (1496 songs, 753 individuals, 6 sites), of which 0 are human-verified and the rest carry stage-4 classifier family labels (Webb 2021 taxonomy). Battery: ARI vs family 0.222, vs individual 0.014, vs site 0.040, vs sex 0.010 — clusters track family taxonomy, not who/where/sex. Density-scale caveat: at coarser HDBSCAN sensitivity (ms=50, mcs=100) the structure collapses to 2 clusters. Explorer shows 3000 of 19815 syllables (human-verified always included); full table ships as kori_syllables.csv. Plus 241 human-verified syllables (separate Koe batch, manual Raven-style annotation) projected in via UMAP.transform with cluster=-3 sentinel (15-NN majority cluster in nn_cluster). Archive join (staged): 6114 syllables from 94 Xeno-Canto + 9 Macaulay Library recordings, segmented by TN v2 (the Koe-validated segmenter, F1 0.902 bird-disjoint held-out; conf 0.6) and projected via UMAP.transform. cluster=-4 sentinel: staged, excluded from cluster claims. 2281 (37%) fall outside the Koe 15-NN envelope — those render hollow; per-recording OUT rates vary 0-100%, the channel/quality signal. XC recordings are curated Anthornis (species confirmed); Macaulay units are catalogued-as only — no ear verification. No cluster-composition or dialect claims on any staged unit. Gate v2 (2026-09-03): flags re-computed on channel-cleaned features (1.5-10 kHz bandpass + noise-gate + RMS norm, applied symmetrically to Koe reference and archive; coordinates unchanged, computed on raw features). 1373/6114 OUT. Gate v3 (2026-09-08): noise-gate prop_decrease 0.85→0.5. Basis: ear pass on the 259 flagged units in the worst 14 recordings — all verified real bird vocalisations (species probable, not ear-certain); quieter-gate diagnosis showed pd=0.85 over-suppressed real syllables (flagged units not quieter, p=0.63; 83% return inside at pd=0.5). OUT 1373→1226 (22.5%→20.1%). Gate logic and explorer coordinates unchanged; raw/pd0.85 flags retained in kori_archive_join.csv for audit.
